## Purpose

Examine a synthetic case separating public-record findings from analyst inference.

## The rule

Synthetic compliance reviews occur every 30 days [@CL-CMP-0001], and unresolved deficiencies trigger a 5 percent billing withhold [@CL-CMP-0002].

## How it works

### Public record

The synthetic review board recorded a 30 days cycle [@CL-CMP-0001] and a 5 percent billing withhold threshold [@CL-CMP-0002].

### Inference

Early pre-review checks reduce the likelihood of triggering the synthetic billing withhold.
